_comment: id -> the date a build first saw this item. Written by scripts/build-shop.mjs, once per
id, and never rewritten. This is the only shared clock the two catalogues have: Vinted
ids and Govinda SKUs both ascend with time but are not comparable to each other, so
'newest first' across a mixed shelf is decided here rather than guessed from an id.
Everything below was stamped on the same run, 2026-08-22, because that is when the file
was introduced. Within one date the sort falls back to Vinted before Govinda, each
newest-first by its own id. That tie stops mattering as real dates accumulate.
ONE MANUAL CORRECTION, 2026-08-22: 9696606450 (Apple Magic Trackpad) is dated 2026-08-19,
the day its photograph was added, rather than the seeding date. It is the only Vinted item
on the Others shelf, so on the seeding tie it would have taken the shelf's home-page tile
ahead of twenty-nine Govinda pieces that are not older than it in any real sense. An
earlier date it can actually be evidenced by was the honest fix. Nothing else is hand-set,
and hand-setting is not a mechanism — it is a correction to seeded data.
